name: Carravogue
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Carravogue is an alternate spelling. It points to the entry Garravogue. The encyclopedia treats the two names as one.
